context: Tests whether the agent turns React Doctor into repository-owned mechanical enforcement instead of relying on optional skill activation, preserves the existing oxlint setup, establishes an advisory baseline before blocking, and verifies the real gate.

checklist.name: React Doctor tooling is repository-owned
checklist.description: package.json and the lockfile own the React Doctor CLI and/or oxlint plugin at a resolved version; checked-in commands do not use @latest

checklist.name: Existing oxlint is preserved
checklist.description: The solution extends the existing oxlint configuration instead of replacing oxlint or adding ESLint solely for React Doctor

checklist.name: Oxlint plugin is configured
checklist.description: .oxlintrc.json registers oxlint-plugin-react-doctor and enables one or more react-doctor rules

checklist.name: Canonical gate remains authoritative
checklist.description: npm run verify continues to run the React-aware lint path and any added full CLI scan; the solution does not create a disconnected local command

checklist.name: Project-level scan distinction
checklist.description: react-readiness.md explains that standalone lint plugins do not cover React Doctor project-level security, configuration, and artifact checks

checklist.name: Pull request CI exists
checklist.description: .github/workflows/react-doctor.yml exists and runs React Doctor for pull requests using the repository's established action-pinning policy

checklist.name: Full history is available
checklist.description: .github/workflows/react-doctor.yml checks out the repository with fetch-depth: 0 so its changed-PR scan can derive the merge base

checklist.name: Initial rollout is advisory
checklist.description: The initial React Doctor CI configuration uses advisory or non-blocking behavior while the baseline and false-positive rate are evaluated

checklist.name: Tightening path is documented
checklist.description: react-readiness.md says when and how to make trusted severities blocking and require the check in branch protection

checklist.name: Permissions are justified
checklist.description: The workflow grants only permissions required for enabled comments, reviews, or statuses, and react-readiness.md explains them

checklist.name: Agent skill is not treated as enforcement
checklist.description: react-readiness.md says optional agent instructions may improve feedback but are not required and do not replace local or CI gates

checklist.name: Known-bad detection is verified
checklist.description: react-readiness.md records or prescribes a disposable known-bad change that proves the local and CI checks actually detect a React Doctor finding
